title: Printers & scanners
blurb: Offline, stuck jobs, wrong printer, scanning.

remedies.title: Print envelopes or labels
remedies.why: Word has tools for envelopes and labels; the printer tray settings must match.

steps.text: Word › Mailings › Envelopes or Labels (pick the label maker and product number).
Feed envelopes as the printer's tray icon shows; set the paper type to Envelope.
Print a test on plain paper and hold it against the label sheet first.

remedies.title: Photos print with the wrong colours or low quality
remedies.why: The paper type and quality settings must match the paper loaded.

steps.text: Choose the exact paper type (e.g. Glossy Photo) and Best quality.
Use the maker's photo paper and genuine ink for accurate colours.

remedies.title: Share a USB printer with other computers
remedies.why: A computer can share its USB printer, but it must stay on.

steps.text: Printer › Printer properties › Sharing › Share this printer.
System Settings › General › Sharing › Printer Sharing.
Better long-term: connect the printer to Wi-Fi or by network cable.

remedies.title: Office print jobs wait for my badge or PIN
remedies.why: Secure printing holds jobs until you're at the printer.

steps.text: Walk to any compatible printer and tap your badge or enter your PIN to release the job.
Jobs are usually deleted if not released within a few hours.

remedies.escalate: Badge or quota problems go to IT.
